title: Yemen President spoke to Trump but Trump made no pledge of military support
description: Reuters -- citing two sources -- reports that Yemen's President spoke to US President Donald Trump on Sunday. Yeme's President asked for miliary help but Trump made no pledges. Oil is down $3.38 to $92.77 today on hopes for a new round of diplomacy to find a way for the US and Iran to end hostilities. That move is boosting the entire risk complex. This article was written by Adam Button at investinglive.com.

title: Bank of Canada’s Macklem: US tariffs could roughly halve fourth-quarter growth to below 1%
description: Comments from Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem cross the wires: If new US tariffs remain in place, Q4 growth could be roughly halved to below 1% If oil prices stay near $100 a barrel, we'd expect inflation to edge up in coming months Fuel prices have risen more than we'd normally expect, reflecting damage to global refining capacity Recent gas prices have been more consistent with an oil price almost $40 higher than where it has been So far we haven't seen evidence that higher oil prices are spreading to other goods and services We don't want to raise rates and restrain growth if inflation
